2607.26055.title: $π\mathbf{R}^2$: Reactive Real-time Flow Policies
2607.26055.paper_summary: Generalist manipulation policies increasingly take the form of action-chunking flow policies built on large pretrained backbones. Such chunks run open-loop, so the policy cannot react to sensory input arriving mid-execution, sacrificing \emph{reactivity}. Replanning more often would restore it, but the perception-to-action pipeline (a large backbone plus multiple denoising steps) is too slow: this \emph{latency} forbids frequent replanning and leaves committed actions stale, making such policies ill-suited for dynamic, closed-loop control. We present $π\mathbf{R}^2$, which makes these policies reactive and real-time while retaining large backbones, expressive multi-modal policies, and multi-action prediction. Built on the per-position noise schedule of diffusion forcing, $π\mathbf{R}^2$ contributes two ideas. First, it splits conditioning into a fast channel (proprioception, fresh every tick) and an asynchronously updated slow channel (vision-language features), so the policy reacts to proprioception within a chunk while tolerating stale vision. Second, a latency-adaptive flow schedule treats in-flight actions as inpainting conditioning and emits actions in one denoising step per call, letting one trained model adapt to varying hardware latency. Requiring minimal modification to existing architectures, $π\mathbf{R}^2$ can be finetuned from a pretrained policy: applied to GR00T-N1.7 on a real xArm6+XHand platform, it replans closed-loop roughly $4\times$ faster than the base policy (~$25$Hz on an A5000 GPU), acting on a fresh observation every $40$ms. Across simulation and real-world manipulation tasks, $π\mathbf{R}^2$ improves the success rate by up to $23\%$ in simulation and $30\%$ in the real world over the strongest baseline. Project page: https://pi-r2-flow.github.io/
2607.26055.paper_summary_zh: 一般化的操控政策越來越多地採用基於大型預訓練骨幹的動作分塊流政策。這些塊以開環方式運行，因此政策無法對執行過程中到達的感官輸入做出反應，犧牲了\emph{反應性}。更頻繁地重新規劃將恢復反應性，但感知到行動的管道（大型骨幹加上多個去噪步驟）太慢：這種\emph{延遲}禁止了頻繁的重新規劃，並使已承諾的行動變得過時，使這些政策不適合動態的閉環控制。我們提出了$π\mathbf{R}^2$，它在保留大型骨幹、表達性多模態政策和多動作預測的同時，使這些政策具備反應性和實時性。基於擴散強迫的每位置噪聲計劃，$π\mathbf{R}^2$提出了兩個想法。首先，它將條件分為快速通道（本體感知，每次更新）和異步更新的慢通道（視覺-語言特徵），因此政策在一個塊內對本體感知做出反應，同時容忍過時的視覺。其次，一種延遲自適應流計劃將進行中的行動視為修補條件，並在每次調用中以一步去噪的方式發出行動，讓一個訓練過的模型適應不同的硬體延遲。$π\mathbf{R}^2$對現有架構的修改要求最小，可以從預訓練的政策進行微調：應用於真實的xArm6+XHand平台上的GR00T-N1.7，它的閉環重新規劃速度約為基礎政策的$4\times$（在A5000 GPU上約為$25$Hz），每$40$毫秒對新觀察進行操作。在模擬和現實世界的操控任務中，$π\mathbf{R}^2$在模擬中提高了成功率高達$23\%$，在現實世界中提高了$30\%$，超過了最強基準。項目頁面：https://pi-r2-flow.github.io/
